title: BGP Active/Idle — dc1-leaf2a EVPN sessions to both spines
symptom: dc1-leaf2a EVPN BGP sessions to dc1-spine1 and dc1-spine2 stuck in Active/Idle state.
root_cause: EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS password set to wrong value on dc1-leaf2a causing MD5 auth mismatch
fix_command:
router bgp 65102
neighbor EVPN-OVERLAY-PEERS password 7 Q4fqtbqcZ7oQuKfuWtNGRQ==
